<thought>We need the precursors obtained by applying retrosynthetic template 1914395 to the fluorinated fragment of the product. The product consists of two fragments: "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". Applying the template retro to the fluorinated fragment will replace the fluorine with a hydroxyl, giving the corresponding alcohol fragment. We'll use the apply_template tool on the fluorinated SMILES with the given template ID.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1", "template_id": "1914395"}</action_input>
